ledger.feature: Real Host CPU, RAM & Process Telemetry
ledger.claim: Live host OS CPU load, RAM, NX RSS, and running processes without Math.random()
ledger.expected: LIVE status and numeric OS metrics
ledger.actual: status=LIVE, value=26; total=4096MB, rss=300MB; status=LIVE, count=12

ledger.feature: Security Policy Guard (C: Protection, Injection & Traversal)
ledger.claim: Blocks destructive OS drive writes, shell injection chaining, and .. path traversal

ledger.feature: Secret Scrubbing & AES-256-GCM Encrypted Multi-Key Vault
ledger.claim: Redacts CNIC/API keys/tokens in logs & stores UI keys encrypted in KeyVault
ledger.expected: Plaintext secrets redacted; vault keys masked as VAULT:...XXXX

ledger.claim: Memory survives restart and corrupted JSON recovers cleanly
ledger.expected: write -> reload -> read matches; corrupted JSON resets safely

ledger.feature: Model Gateway Live Gemini Probe & Failover
ledger.claim: Per-profile live Gemini API validation and automatic 429/401 multi-key failover
ledger.expected: HTTP 200 live Gemini response when valid API key configured; AUTH_FAILED/QUOTA_EXHAUSTED otherwise

ledger.feature: Storage Discovery, FAT32 Check & SHA-256 Transactional Copy
ledger.claim: Discovers live volumes, blocks >4GB on FAT32, performs atomic temp+checksum+rename copy
ledger.expected: PASS on local filesystem; physical USB eject requires Windows removable drive

ledger.claim: Inspects HWND foreground window and launches allowlisted Windows apps
ledger.expected: HWND/process metadata on Windows; honest WINDOWS_HOST_REQUIRED on Linux
ledger.actual: WINDOWS_HOST_REQUIRED: Win32 foreground window inspection requires Windows host (current: linux).

ledger.claim: Discovers Chrome/Edge CDP sessions, Observe -> Act -> Re-observe, stops at CAPTCHA/OTP/Payment
ledger.expected: Live CDP session when Chrome/Edge running; UNAVAILABLE when absent

ledger.claim: Runs real adb devices -l with no hardcoded devices
ledger.actual: UNAVAILABLE: Android Platform Tools (adb) not found in PATH or ADB daemon offline.

ledger.feature: AES-256-GCM Customer Vault, Masking & Owner Reveal
ledger.claim: Stores customer CNIC/IMEI/phone encrypted on disk, masks defaults, and enforces Owner Mode for reveal/delete/backup
ledger.expected: Encrypted file data/nx_customer_vault.json, *****1234 masking, 403 CUSTOMER_MODE_REVEAL_BLOCKED in CUSTOMER_SAFE

ledger.feature: Dynamic Capability Registry, Owner/Customer Mode & Editable Persona
ledger.claim: Exposes live 18-capability inventory, 6 behavior profiles, 6 female wake aliases, and R0-R5 risk policy decomposition
ledger.expected: Dynamic capabilities match live host state; CUSTOMER_MODE overrides affectionate aliases cleanly

ledger.claim: Legacy companion UI, endpoints, and assets removed; new character work frozen
ledger.expected: HTTP 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND on legacy companion paths; 0 violations in hygiene scan
ledger.actual: No legacy companion routes mounted; character code/assets absent
